name: Youth Accountability Board Member
org: City of Pomona Department of Children and Youth
what_you_do: Help watch over Pomona's Children and Youth Fund. The board reviews grant requests and suggests grants to the City Council. It checks that funded programs work, and it meets in public at least 6 times a year.
who_can_apply: Pomona youth. Each City Council member appoints one youth from their district, and the Mayor appoints two youth at large. The page gives no age range for youth members.
deadline_text: No application dates or open seats are posted on the page.
how_to_apply: The page does not explain how to apply. Youth members are appointed by their City Council member or the Mayor, so contact your council member's office or the Department of Children and Youth.
notes: Confirm first: the page has no application, age range or term length. The department serves children and youth from birth through age 24.
